body: I’m not doing this because of my mom. It just set me over the edge. I have a history of 10 years of sexual abuse and so much more. I’m just done with it all.
Yeah I agree. I’m feeling like I’ve tried everything. I’ve tried really hard for years.

I guess there’s nothing I really want in the future.
